name: Wrapped M
oneLiner: wM is M0 Protocol's non-rebasing 1:1 ERC-20 wrapper around M, with M backed by short-term U.S. Treasury bills held in bankruptcy-remote SPVs.
collateral: Underlying M (M0 Protocol) is backed 100% by short-term U.S. Treasury bills (30–90 day WAM) held in bankruptcy-remote SPVs by permissioned Minters; M0 Validators independently attest collateral sufficiency on-chain before any M can be minted, and wM holds M 1:1 inside the Wrapped M Token contract
pegMechanism: Non-rebasing 1:1 ERC-20 wrapper around M: anyone can call wrap() to deposit M and mint wM, or unwrap() to redeem wM back to M at any time without fees or queues; wM holders are non-earning by default, so yield accrued by the underlying M is redirected via TTG-approved earner accounts and the claimExcess() mechanism to ecosystem yield recipients (downstream M0 extensions and apps), leaving wM as a flat USD-denominated unit

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: M0 documentation establishes wM as an M-token wrapper and describes the collateral framework, but the reviewed sources do not provide the complete current assurance, reconciliation, custody continuity, valuation, seniority, and loss-recovery inputs required for a full mechanism review.

mintAuthority.summary: wM is an EIP-1967 minimal proxy (no admin slot, no UUPS) over WrappedMToken — wrap/unwrap is pure M-backed accounting with no privileged mint path. The contract's Migratable mechanism allows implementation changes, but only when a TTG-registered migrator key exists AND is called by migrationAdmin (a 2/2 Safe, v1.3.0, no modules). Base M issuance is inherited from reviewed m-m0 MinterGateway controls.

controls.label: WrappedMToken EIP-1967 proxy (Migratable)
controls.capDescription: EIP-1967 minimal proxy with no admin slot; upgrade requires TTG-registered migrator AND migrationAdmin (2/2 Safe) to call migrate(). vault()=0xd7298f620b0f752cf41bd818a16c756d9dcaa34f confirmed. Wrapper mints wM only by wrapping deposited M.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295240: EIP-1967 impl slot = 0x813b926b1d096e117721bd1eb017fba122302da0 (WrappedMToken, verified); no EIP-1967 admin slot (0x0); proxy code is a pure EIP-1967 minimal forwarder with no upgrade functions. migrationAdmin() selector 0x74df2558 returned 0x431169728d75bd02f4053435b87d15c8d1fb2c72; that address getOwners()=[0xdcf79c..., 0xe0c6ac...], threshold=2, masterCopy=0xd9db270c (v1.3.0), getModulesPaginated sentinel only (no modules), guard slot=0x0. vault()=0xd7298f... confirmed via 0xfbfa77cf. Migration additionally requires TTG Registrar key wm_migrator_v1 to be populated.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: M0 documents an Ethereum hub and spoke portal architecture for bridging M and wM, where hub-side tokens are locked and spoke-side representations are minted or burned by M0 portal contracts. Because the route is protocol-operated rather than a generic external bridge, wM is scored as issuer-native-lock-mint.
